topic: He only writes after midnight — by day you don't exist
prompt:
No host. No woman. No Victoria. No Виктория.png. No presenter face. Style lock = palette only (#111111 + white heavy sans + #ff006e), not a face.
One static PNG 3:4@4K, grid 3×3. Thin white gutters at 1/3 and 2/3 (Excalibur). Text ≥12% from seams. Animals + objects only. Verbatim text, no substitutions, no extra labels, no duplicate text. No video.
Preserve: dark field, magenta+white type, seam gutters, no host. Change: midnight-window + this copy. Do not borrow: weekend suitcase, horror, Виктория.png, bot, Academy.

01 owl, phone 00:47, lamp, waveform: "00:47 voice note. 2:20 PM — no ticks.".
02 dog at dark day screen: "Chosen at night. Empty by day." / "At 00:47 you feel picked. At 2:20 PM you check the chat as if midnight could move into daylight. It didn't. You wait on his clock, not yours.".
03 dog, 1:12 clock: "You slide sleep to his 1:12 AM" / "You shift your night to his text and call it the real us. That is not proof. That is your night given to his window.".
04 owl at night window: "Midnight is hours without witnesses" / "He has a window from midnight to 3 AM. In his daylight schedule there is no seat for you. Night heat is not a place in his day.".
05 cat, decoder: "Says / Hears / Is" / "Says: «I can only text at night.» Hears: «I'm the exception.» Is: you are not in his day.".
06 cat, 1-2-3: "3 daylight checks" / "1. Does he write in daylight? 2. Does he write in a sober day? 3. Is there a door besides the night channel?".
07 dog stands from screen: "3 questions before his midnight" / "1. Did he write today in the light? 2. Am I waiting for 00:00 or living my day? 3. If the night vanishes — what is left?".
08 owl recap: "Night without day is a window" / "Rule: a place in his life shows in daylight. If you exist only after midnight, you are not in his day.".
09 huge magenta MIDNIGHT, owl + phone/app, no person: "Comment MIDNIGHT" / "Audio reading in the app." / "Essence–Shadow–Vector".
